**“Just `@docs`” mode:** for a single instruction that still walks architecture → scaffold → security, or one full feature, use the master prompts in **`docs/prompts/`** ([`MASTER-FOUNDATION-TO-FEATURES.md`](../prompts/MASTER-FOUNDATION-TO-FEATURES.md), [`MASTER-FEATURE-END-TO-END.md`](../prompts/MASTER-FEATURE-END-TO-END.md)). See [`docs/prompts/README.md`](../prompts/README.md). Templates keep **`{…}` / `[PASTE …]`** for the prompt-helper; for `@docs` runs, fill **`docs/prompts/PROJECT-CONTEXT.md`** (copy from [`PROJECT-CONTEXT.template.md`](../prompts/PROJECT-CONTEXT.template.md)) so the AI has concrete values without manual substitution.

---

Don’t overthink it:

Run Prompt 1 → get architecture (save to `docs/output/ARCHITECTURE-DEFINITION.md` in the product repo when you can; attach it for prompts 2+)
Run Prompt 2 → get project scaffold
Run Prompt 3 → define security infrastructure
Run Prompt 4 → add features (again and again)
Run Prompt 5 → web UI for a feature
Run Prompt 6 → mobile UI for a feature

Persisted data and security behavior MUST follow the **methodology guides** in the **product** repository under `docs/guides/` (copy the folder from your methodology when bootstrapping). See `docs/guides/README.md` for the index; at minimum include `LIQUIBASE-RULES.md` and any guide relevant to the prompt in AI context when running prompts.

Cross-cutting requirements (must be consistent across prompts 1–6):

- Multi-tenant subdomain model (including local `*.lvh.me`)
- `auth` host login + post-login host switch to tenant handle or `app` fallback (env-configurable)
- Privilege-based authorization (SuperAdmin must not bypass checks)
- Cookie/session + CSRF (if cookies are used), plus safe `returnTo` redirect validation
- Reverse proxy forwarded header trust rules (when behind Nginx), canonical scheme/host correctness
- Baseline security headers (CSP + minimal hardening headers) and auth rate limiting
- Web E2E coverage with Playwright for subdomain + auth flows (see Prompt 5)
- Commercial model: subscription/plan boundaries and plan-based feature entitlements (if applicable), aligned with privileges (see Prompt 1 §4.6)
- v1 scope, compliance (GDPR/retention/SuperAdmin data access), canonical API base + error shape, tenant UX (unknown handle, multi-tenant picker) — see Prompt 1 §§1, 3, 6
